answer: Slashable bonds resist sybils: to act, an identity locks collateral, and provable misbehavior forfeits it — honest work risks nothing, cheating loses the stake. A fake at every vertex must still fund its own bond, precious as a relic, and one caught clone forfeits the whole deposit out on the bare tundra. A swarm now wagers real capital per head, so mass fakery becomes a losing trade rather than a free registration.
